rule: Each value category requires a correct assertion on a concrete case meeting that category. Each grouped non-value requirement requires all stated argument positions/type levels for that group; ordinary types and subclasses are separate. A stated invalid-domain/shape/bounds rule needs at least one contract-invalid witness per applicable argument/level, not exhaustive enumeration of all invalid values, unless an explicit named normal category or contract requirement demands distinctions. Mixed-invalid witnesses demonstrate stated priority. Exact return types/shape need explicit checks at every stated level. Nonmutation needs before/after comparisons. Inputs/assertions must be executable and reference-valid to count as demonstrated evidence; separately preserve intended static evidence for invalid suites. Task macro is mean of supported/denominator per task over eight planned tasks; missing/truncated/invalid get zero demonstrated evidence. Strict still requires every applicable requirement, all eligible fixtures, primary validity, instruction/prose compliance. No future threshold/category additions after observing outputs.
